variant_desc: int64_t field over [0,255] in 64B struct (1 record/line) -> uint8_t array (64 records/line) (variant 2: seed=44, n_scale=1.5x)
novelty_rationale: Tests recognition that an int64_t field whose runtime values lie in [0,255] should be redeclared as uint8_t. The optimization is purely a data-layout densification (8x cache-line packing) that no compiler can perform because struct field width is an ABI invariant — other translation units, serialized formats, and mmap'd views may depend on the exact 8-byte layout.
